problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}1 & 10 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}]x(t)
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above.
Find the unknown function $f(t)$ in the general solution to the system, shown below.

$$
\text{x}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+3\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{2t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)-3\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t) \\ f(t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{2t}
$$

*Hint: The matrix has the eigenvalue ${\lambda }_{1}=2+3\text{i}$ with the corresponding eigenvector ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1-3\text{i} \\ 1\end{aligned}].$*
